name: Fireball
description: Hurls a ball of fire where you aim; it bursts on whatever it meets.

name: Air Slash
description: A standing crescent of air flies 9 m ahead and cuts every enemy in its path.

name: Earth Crack
description: Strikes the ground and splits it in a small V ahead, hurting everything it runs under.

name: Summon Spears
description: Three burning spears appear over your head and shoot one by one at the nearest enemies.

name: Fang Slash
description: A savage swipe tears three red crescents from the air, side by side.
